review_note: Reviewed EXT002 and K054S01. NHLBI directly explains that atrial fibrillation causes ineffective cardiac pumping that permits blood pooling and clot formation. AHA explicitly confirms that abnormal atrial contractions can cause blood pooling within the atria and increase the risk of atrial thrombus formation. Together the verified passages support Atrial fibrillation → Atrial thrombus formation as RISK_FACTOR_FOR. This is not deterministic because not every patient develops an atrial clot. review_note: Reviewed K054S02 and SRC002. The AHA directly states that a clot originating in the atria can travel to the brain and block a cerebral artery, causing embolic ischemic stroke. This supports Atrial thrombus formation → Cardioembolic ischemic stroke as a conditional causal relationship. Thrombus embolization and cerebral arterial obstruction are required additional events; clot formation alone does not establish stroke. SRC002 supports the general embolic ischemic stroke mechanism but does not explicitly establish the atrial origin, so it remains partial and is excluded from supporting_source_ids. Neither source establishes this pathway for hemorrhagic stroke. AI-assisted review; human confirmation pending.
